meals.name: Greek Yogurt Bowl with Berries & Oat Granola
meals.image_prompt: overhead shot of a white ceramic bowl filled with creamy Greek yogurt topped with fresh mixed berries and crunchy golden granola, small drizzle of honey, natural morning light on a light wooden table
prep_steps: Measure and portion granola into two labelled containers (Diego 60g, Diana 40g) on Sunday
day_of_steps: 1. Remove yogurt from fridge.
2. Spoon 220g Greek yogurt (0% fat) into Diego's bowl; spoon 160g into Diana's bowl.
3. Top Diego's bowl with 100g mixed berries (fresh or thawed from frozen); Diana gets 80g.
4. Sprinkle pre-portioned granola over each bowl (Diego 60g, Diana 40g).
5. Drizzle 1 tsp honey over each bowl and serve immediately.

meals.name: Apple & Almond Butter
meals.image_prompt: sliced green apple fanned on a small plate beside a small ramekin of creamy almond butter, natural side light, minimalist styling
day_of_steps: 1. Wash and core 1 apple per person.
2. Slice each apple into 8 wedges.
3. Measure almond butter: 20g for Diego, 15g for Diana, into small dipping bowls.
4. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Mediterranean Chicken & Quinoa Bowl with Roasted Vegetables
meals.image_prompt: colourful bowl of fluffy quinoa topped with sliced golden roasted chicken breast, roasted red pepper strips, courgette, cherry tomatoes, and a drizzle of green herb dressing, natural daylight, overhead angle
prep_steps: Cook 400g dry quinoa in salted water Sunday (yields ~1kg cooked); store in fridge
Roast 2 courgettes and 3 red peppers cut into chunks with olive oil at 200°C for 25 min Sunday; store in fridge
Bake 700g chicken breast seasoned with oregano, garlic powder, salt at 200°C for 22 min Sunday; slice and store in fridge
day_of_steps: 1. Portion cold quinoa into microwave-safe bowls: Diego 200g cooked, Diana 140g cooked.
2. Add roasted veg on top: Diego ~120g, Diana ~90g.
3. Add sliced cooked chicken: Diego 150g, Diana 110g.
4. Microwave bowls for 2 min on high, stir halfway.
5. Add 6–8 halved cherry tomatoes per bowl (fresh, no heating needed).
6. Drizzle 1 tbsp olive oil + squeeze of lemon juice over each bowl.
7. Season with salt, pepper, dried oregano and serve.

ingredients.item: Cooked chicken breast (blanc de poulet cuit)
Roasted courgette & red pepper (courgette et poivron rouge rôtis)
Cooked chicken breast (blanc de poulet cuit)
Roasted courgette & red pepper (courgette et poivron rouge rôtis)

meals.name: Hummus & Carrot Sticks
meals.image_prompt: small bowl of smooth golden hummus surrounded by bright orange carrot sticks on a white plate, sprinkle of paprika on hummus, natural soft light
prep_steps: Peel and cut 4 large carrots into sticks Sunday; store in a sealed container with a damp paper towel
day_of_steps: 1. Take pre-cut carrot sticks from fridge: Diego ~120g, Diana ~100g.
2. Spoon hummus into small bowls: Diego 60g, Diana 50g.
3. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Salmon with Lentil & Spinach Stew
meals.image_prompt: a pan-seared salmon fillet with crispy golden skin resting on a rustic bowl of green lentil and wilted spinach stew, lemon wedge on side, warm evening light, shallow depth of field
prep_steps: Cook 300g dry green lentils with diced carrots, celery, canned tomatoes, garlic, cumin, smoked paprika in vegetable stock Sunday for 30 min; cool and refrigerate
day_of_steps: 1. Take lentil stew from fridge; portion into a saucepan: Diego 300g, Diana 220g.
2. Add a large handful of fresh baby spinach (80g total) to the pan; heat over medium, stirring until spinach wilts (3–4 min).
3. Meanwhile, pat salmon fillets dry with kitchen paper.
4. Season each fillet with salt, pepper, and a pinch of smoked paprika.
5. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
6. Place salmon skin-side down; cook 4 min without moving. Flip, cook 2–3 min more until just cooked through.
7. Ladle stew into bowls; place salmon fillet on top.
8. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over salmon and serve.

ingredients.item: Cooked lentil stew (ragoût de lentilles cuit)
Cooked lentil stew (ragoût de lentilles cuit)

meals.name: Overnight Oats with Banana & Peanut Butter
meals.image_prompt: two glass jars of thick overnight oats layered with banana slices and a swirl of peanut butter on top, soft morning light, marble surface, fresh and wholesome
prep_steps: Mix rolled oats with milk and a pinch of cinnamon Sunday evening in jars (Diego: 90g oats + 220ml milk; Diana: 65g oats + 160ml milk); refrigerate overnight
day_of_steps: 1. Remove overnight oat jars from fridge.
2. Stir each jar briefly.
3. Slice half a banana over Diego's jar; slice half a banana over Diana's jar.
4. Add 1 tbsp peanut butter on top of Diego's portion; 1 tsp on Diana's.
5. Serve cold directly from jar.

meals.name: Cottage Cheese & Cucumber Slices
meals.image_prompt: a small bowl of white cottage cheese with fresh cucumber rounds arranged around it, sprinkle of black pepper and fresh dill, crisp natural light on white background
day_of_steps: 1. Slice 1/2 cucumber into rounds per person.
2. Spoon cottage cheese into small bowls: Diego 200g, Diana 150g.
3. Season with black pepper and a pinch of dried dill.
4. Serve cucumber alongside.

meals.name: Chicken Quinoa Bowl (Batch Leftover)
meals.image_prompt: vibrant lunch bowl with fluffy quinoa, golden sliced chicken breast, colourful roasted vegetables, drizzle of lemon-herb dressing, photographed from above in natural light
day_of_steps: 1. Portion cold quinoa: Diego 200g, Diana 140g into microwave-safe bowls.
2. Add leftover roasted veg: Diego 120g, Diana 90g.
3. Add sliced cooked chicken: Diego 150g, Diana 110g.
4. Microwave 2 min on high, stir halfway.
5. Top with fresh cherry tomatoes, a drizzle of olive oil and lemon juice.
6. Season with salt, pepper and serve.

ingredients.item: Cooked chicken breast (blanc de poulet cuit)
Roasted courgette & red pepper (courgette et poivron rouge rôtis)
Cooked chicken breast (blanc de poulet cuit)
Roasted courgette & red pepper (courgette et poivron rouge rôtis)

meals.name: Mixed Nuts & Orange
meals.image_prompt: a small wooden bowl of mixed nuts beside a peeled orange broken into segments on a light stone surface, natural afternoon light
day_of_steps: 1. Measure mixed unsalted nuts: Diego 30g, Diana 20g into small bowls.
2. Peel 1 orange per person and separate into segments.
3. Serve nuts and orange together.

ingredients.item: Mixed unsalted nuts (noix mélangées non salées)
Mixed unsalted nuts (noix mélangées non salées)

meals.name: Asian Tofu & Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
meals.image_prompt: steaming wok-tossed tofu and broccoli stir-fry with vibrant red pepper and snap peas over fluffy brown rice, sesame seeds scattered on top, chopsticks resting on bowl, warm kitchen light
prep_steps: Cook 350g dry brown rice Sunday (yields ~900g cooked); cool and refrigerate
Press and cube 600g firm tofu; marinate in soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic powder Sunday; store covered in fridge
day_of_steps: 1. Heat 1 tsp sesame oil in a large non-stick wok or pan over high heat.
2. Add marinated tofu cubes; stir-fry 5–6 min until golden on all sides, then set aside on a plate.
3. In the same wok add 1 tsp oil; add broccoli florets (Diego 100g, Diana 80g) and sliced red pepper (Diego 80g, Diana 60g); stir-fry 4 min.
4. Add snap peas (50g each), stir-fry 1 min more.
5. Return tofu to pan; add 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp oyster sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp fresh grated ginger; toss everything 1–2 min.
6. Microwave portioned cold brown rice: Diego 220g, Diana 160g for 2 min.
7. Serve stir-fry over rice; sprinkle sesame seeds on top.

meals.name: Scrambled Eggs on Wholegrain Toast with Avocado
meals.image_prompt: soft creamy scrambled eggs piled on toasted dark wholegrain bread topped with sliced avocado and a pinch of red pepper flakes, fresh herbs, bright morning kitchen light
day_of_steps: 1. Toast 2 slices wholegrain bread for Diego; 1 slice for Diana.
2. Crack 3 eggs into Diego's bowl; 2 eggs into Diana's bowl. Add a splash of milk each, salt and pepper; whisk well.
3. Heat a non-stick pan over low-medium heat, add a small knob of butter.
4. Pour in Diego's eggs; fold gently with a spatula until just set (2–3 min). Repeat for Diana.
5. Halve one avocado; scoop 1/4 avocado onto Diego's toast, 1/4 onto Diana's toast. Mash lightly.
6. Top toast with scrambled eggs.
7. Squeeze lemon juice over avocado; sprinkle chilli flakes and serve.

meals.name: Rice Cakes with Cottage Cheese & Tomato
meals.image_prompt: two rice cakes spread with white cottage cheese and topped with thin tomato slices, fresh basil leaf, pinch of salt, rustic wooden board, natural daylight
day_of_steps: 1. Place 2 rice cakes on a plate for Diego; 2 for Diana.
2. Spread 50g cottage cheese on Diego's cakes; 40g on Diana's.
3. Slice 1 small tomato per person; lay slices on top.
4. Season with salt and pepper; add a fresh basil leaf if available.

meals.name: Lentil & Spinach Stew (Batch Leftover) with Crusty Bread
meals.image_prompt: a deep bowl of rustic green lentil stew with wilted spinach and carrot pieces, steam rising, thick crusty slice of whole wheat bread on the side, warm natural light
day_of_steps: 1. Portion leftover lentil stew into saucepan: Diego 320g, Diana 240g.
2. Add fresh spinach (50g each) and heat over medium for 3–4 min, stirring.
3. Taste and adjust seasoning with cumin, salt, pepper.
4. Serve in bowls with 1 slice wholegrain bread for Diego (40g), 1 slice for Diana (40g).

ingredients.item: Cooked lentil stew (ragoût de lentilles cuit)
Cooked lentil stew (ragoût de lentilles cuit)

meals.name: Greek Yogurt with Walnuts
meals.image_prompt: a small ceramic bowl of thick Greek yogurt topped with walnut halves and a light drizzle of honey, soft afternoon light on marble counter
day_of_steps: 1. Spoon 150g Greek yogurt into Diego's bowl; 120g into Diana's.
2. Top with walnut halves: Diego 20g, Diana 15g.
3. Drizzle 1 tsp honey over each bowl and serve.

meals.name: Mexican Black Bean & Turkey Taco Bowls
meals.image_prompt: colourful taco bowl with seasoned ground turkey, black beans, shredded red cabbage, diced tomato, corn, sliced avocado and a lime wedge over brown rice, vibrant and fresh, overhead shot, natural evening light
prep_steps: Cook remaining brown rice (if not enough left from batch 3): use batch_3 rice
Drain and rinse 2 cans black beans Sunday; store in fridge
day_of_steps: 1. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat; add 400g (total) lean ground turkey (dinde hachée).
2. Break turkey apart with a spatula; cook 6–7 min until browned.
3. Add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, salt, pepper; stir 1 min.
4. Add rinsed black beans (Diego 120g, Diana 80g) and 100ml water; simmer 3 min.
5. Microwave cold brown rice: Diego 200g, Diana 150g for 2 min.
6. Assemble bowls: rice base, then turkey-bean mix (Diego ~230g meat+bean, Diana ~170g), then toppings.
7. Top with shredded red cabbage (40g each), diced tomato (60g each), corn kernels (30g each).
8. Add sliced avocado (1/4 each) and a squeeze of lime; serve immediately.

ingredients.item: Black beans canned (haricots noirs en boîte)
Black beans canned (haricots noirs en boîte)

meals.name: Greek Yogurt Bowl with Berries & Granola
meals.image_prompt: creamy white Greek yogurt bowl topped with ruby-red raspberries, blueberries and crunchy granola clusters, light drizzle of honey, overhead shot in bright morning light on a wooden surface
day_of_steps: 1. Spoon 220g Greek yogurt into Diego's bowl; 160g into Diana's.
2. Add 100g mixed berries to Diego's bowl; 80g to Diana's.
3. Sprinkle 60g granola over Diego's bowl; 40g over Diana's.
4. Drizzle 1 tsp honey over each and serve.

meals.name: Banana & Peanut Butter
meals.image_prompt: a whole banana beside a small ceramic bowl of smooth peanut butter on a bright wooden table, natural morning light, wholesome and simple
day_of_steps: 1. Peel 1 banana per person.
2. Measure peanut butter: Diego 20g, Diana 12g in small bowls.
3. Serve banana with peanut butter for dipping.

meals.name: Asian Tofu & Brown Rice Bowl (Batch Leftover)
meals.image_prompt: cold and refreshing rice bowl with golden tofu cubes, broccoli, red pepper strips, edamame on brown rice, drizzle of soy-sesame dressing, natural light from above
day_of_steps: 1. Portion leftover tofu stir-fry: Diego 250g, Diana 190g.
2. Microwave with brown rice (Diego 200g, Diana 150g) for 2 min on high.
3. Stir and taste; add extra soy sauce or sesame oil if needed.
4. Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve.

ingredients.item: Leftover tofu stir-fry (sauté de tofu restes)
Leftover tofu stir-fry (sauté de tofu restes)

meals.name: Hummus & Bell Pepper Strips
meals.image_prompt: colourful red, yellow and green bell pepper strips arranged around a bowl of creamy hummus on a white plate, sprinkle of paprika, fresh and vibrant, natural light
prep_steps: Slice bell peppers into strips Sunday and store in fridge
day_of_steps: 1. Take pre-cut bell pepper strips from fridge: ~100g each.
2. Spoon hummus: Diego 60g, Diana 50g.
3. Serve immediately.

meals.name: French-Style Baked Cod with Ratatouille & Wholegrain Couscous
meals.image_prompt: a golden baked cod fillet resting on a colourful ratatouille of courgette, aubergine and tomatoes, with fluffy couscous alongside, lemon slices, parsley, warm oven-baked glow, rustic ceramic dish
prep_steps: Dice 1 aubergine, 2 courgettes, 2 tomatoes; sauté with garlic, herbes de Provence, olive oil Sunday for 15 min; cool and refrigerate as ratatouille base
day_of_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 200°C.
2. Place cod fillets (Diego 180g, Diana 130g) in a baking dish.
3. Season cod with salt, pepper, lemon zest and a drizzle of olive oil.
4. Spoon ratatouille (Diego 200g, Diana 160g) around and over fish.
5. Bake 18–20 min until fish flakes easily with a fork.
6. Meanwhile, pour boiling water over couscous (Diego 70g dry, Diana 55g dry) in bowls; cover with a plate for 5 min, then fluff with a fork.
7. Serve cod and ratatouille over couscous; garnish with fresh parsley.

ingredients.item: Fresh lemon zest (zeste de citron frais)
Fresh lemon zest (zeste de citron frais)

meals.name: Overnight Oats with Berries & Chia Seeds
meals.image_prompt: two glass jars of thick overnight oats with chia seeds, dotted with blueberries and raspberries, morning light, spoon resting in jar, wholesome and fresh
prep_steps: Prepare overnight oats Thursday evening: mix oats + chia seeds + milk in jars (Diego: 90g oats + 10g chia + 220ml milk; Diana: 65g oats + 8g chia + 160ml milk); refrigerate
day_of_steps: 1. Remove jars from fridge; give each a good stir.
2. Top Diego's jar with 80g mixed berries; Diana's with 60g.
3. Drizzle 1 tsp honey over each; serve cold.

meals.name: Hard-Boiled Egg & Cherry Tomatoes
meals.image_prompt: two halved hard-boiled eggs beside a small cluster of red cherry tomatoes on a small white plate, sprinkle of paprika, bright and clean natural light
prep_steps: Boil 6 eggs Sunday until hard (10 min); peel, refrigerate in a sealed container
day_of_steps: 1. Take pre-boiled eggs from fridge: Diego 2 eggs, Diana 1 egg.
2. Halve eggs; sprinkle with a pinch of paprika and salt.
3. Add 80g cherry tomatoes to each plate.
4. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Mexican Bean Bowl with Turkey (Batch Leftover)
meals.image_prompt: a warm bowl with seasoned turkey mince and black beans on a bed of brown rice, topped with shredded cabbage, corn and avocado slices, fresh lime wedge, natural midday light
day_of_steps: 1. Portion leftover turkey-bean mix from fridge into a pan: Diego 230g, Diana 170g.
2. Heat over medium for 4 min, stirring; add a splash of water if needed.
3. Microwave cooked brown rice: Diego 180g, Diana 130g for 2 min.
4. Assemble bowls: rice, then turkey-bean mix, then leftover toppings (cabbage, corn, tomato).
5. Slice fresh avocado (1/4 per person) on top; squeeze lime and serve.

ingredients.item: Leftover turkey-bean mix (restes de dinde et haricots)
Leftover turkey-bean mix (restes de dinde et haricots)

meals.name: Apple & Mixed Nuts
meals.image_prompt: green apple slices fanned next to a small wooden bowl of mixed nuts, afternoon light, clean styling on a white surface
day_of_steps: 1. Core and slice 1 apple per person.
2. Measure mixed nuts: Diego 25g, Diana 20g.
3. Serve together.

ingredients.item: Mixed unsalted nuts (noix mélangées non salées)
Mixed unsalted nuts (noix mélangées non salées)

meals.name: Ratatouille Omelette with Wholegrain Toast
meals.image_prompt: a fluffy golden omelette folded over colourful ratatouille filling on a white plate, slice of wholegrain toast alongside, fresh parsley garnish, warm cozy kitchen evening light
day_of_steps: 1. Warm leftover ratatouille in a small pan: Diego 150g, Diana 120g; set aside.
2. Crack 3 eggs into Diego's bowl; 2 into Diana's. Whisk with salt and pepper.
3. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
4. Pour in Diego's egg mixture; cook until edges set (1–2 min), then add ratatouille filling on one half.
5. Fold omelette over filling; slide onto plate. Repeat for Diana.
6. Toast 1 slice wholegrain bread each; serve alongside.
7. Garnish with fresh parsley.

meals.name: French Buckwheat Crêpes with Cottage Cheese & Fruit
meals.image_prompt: thin golden buckwheat crêpes rolled and filled with white cottage cheese and fresh sliced strawberries on a rustic plate, dusting of powdered sugar, warm weekend morning light, café-style
day_of_steps: 1. In a bowl mix 120g buckwheat flour (farine de sarrasin), 1 egg, 300ml semi-skimmed milk, pinch of salt; whisk smooth.
2. Heat a 26cm non-stick pan over medium heat; add a drop of oil or butter.
3. Pour a small ladle of batter; tilt pan to spread thin. Cook 1–2 min per side. Repeat for ~6 crêpes total.
4. Give Diego 3 crêpes; Diana 2 crêpes.
5. Fill each crêpe with cottage cheese (Diego total 150g, Diana total 100g) and sliced strawberries (Diego 100g, Diana 80g).
6. Roll or fold; serve immediately.

meals.name: Orange & Walnuts
meals.image_prompt: a peeled orange broken into segments beside a small handful of walnut halves on a light ceramic plate, cheerful morning light
day_of_steps: 1. Peel 1 orange per person; separate into segments.
2. Measure walnuts: Diego 25g, Diana 20g.
3. Serve together.

meals.name: Mediterranean Tuna Nicoise Salad
meals.image_prompt: a generous Niçoise salad with chunks of tuna, hard-boiled egg halves, green beans, cherry tomatoes, black olives and boiled potatoes on a bed of mixed greens, Dijon vinaigrette drizzled over, natural light, elegant plating
day_of_steps: 1. Boil 2 medium potatoes per person until tender (15 min); cool, halve.
2. Blanch green beans (Diego 80g, Diana 60g) in boiling salted water 3 min; drain and rinse cold.
3. Halve pre-boiled eggs: Diego 2, Diana 1 (from batch_10 if remaining, or freshly boiled).
4. Make dressing: whisk 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp Dijon mustard (moutarde de Dijon), 1 tbsp red wine vinegar (vinaigre de vin rouge), salt, pepper.
5. Arrange on plates: mixed greens base, then green beans, cherry tomatoes, olives, potato halves, egg halves.
6. Top with drained canned tuna (Diego 120g, Diana 80g) in water.
7. Drizzle dressing over each salad and serve.

ingredients.item: Canned tuna in water (thon en boîte au naturel)
Red wine vinegar (vinaigre de vin rouge)
Canned tuna in water (thon en boîte au naturel)
Red wine vinegar (vinaigre de vin rouge)

meals.name: Carrot Sticks & Cottage Cheese Dip
meals.image_prompt: bright orange carrot sticks alongside a small white pot of herb-seasoned cottage cheese dip, fresh parsley garnish, natural light, clean and healthy styling
day_of_steps: 1. Peel and cut 2 carrots per person into sticks.
2. Spoon cottage cheese into bowls: Diego 80g, Diana 60g; season with dried herbs.
3. Serve carrot sticks with cottage cheese dip.

meals.name: French Chicken Provençal with Steamed Broccoli & Bulgur
meals.image_prompt: golden braised chicken thighs in a rich herbes de Provence tomato sauce with olives and capers, served alongside bright green steamed broccoli and fluffy bulgur wheat, rustic French ceramic dish, candlelit warm evening light
day_of_steps: 1. Season chicken thighs (Diego 2 thighs ~220g boneless, Diana 1 thigh ~150g) with herbes de Provence, salt, pepper.
2. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat; sear chicken skin-side down 4–5 min until golden; flip and cook 3 min.
3. Add 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes (tomates concassées), 10 black olives, 1 tbsp capers (câpres), 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1/2 tsp dried thyme.
4. Cover and simmer 15 min until chicken is cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, cook bulgur (boulgour): pour boiling water over Diego 70g dry, Diana 55g dry in bowls; cover 8 min, fluff with fork.
6. Steam broccoli florets (Diego 100g, Diana 80g) for 5 min or microwave with 2 tbsp water covered 3 min.
7. Serve chicken and sauce over bulgur with broccoli alongside.

ingredients.item: Boneless chicken thighs (cuisses de poulet désossées)
Canned crushed tomatoes (tomates concassées en boîte)
Boneless chicken thighs (cuisses de poulet désossées)
Canned crushed tomatoes (tomates concassées en boîte)

meals.name: Veggie Frittata with Wholegrain Toast
meals.image_prompt: thick golden frittata with colourful zucchini, red pepper and spinach, cut into generous slices on a white ceramic plate with dark wholegrain toast, fresh herbs on top, bright Sunday morning light
day_of_steps: 1. Preheat oven grill/broiler to 180°C.
2. Dice 1/2 courgette, 1/2 red pepper into small cubes; wilt a handful of spinach in a non-stick oven-safe pan with 1 tsp olive oil, 3 min.
3. Whisk together: 4 eggs for Diego + Diana combined (2.5 per Diego equivalent), add salt, pepper, 1 tbsp grated Parmesan (parmesan râpé).
4. Pour egg mix over veg in the pan; cook on hob on low until edges set (3–4 min).
5. Transfer pan to oven; bake 8–10 min until top is set and golden.
6. Cut frittata: Diego gets 3/5 of it, Diana gets 2/5.
7. Toast 1 slice wholegrain bread each; serve alongside frittata.

meals.name: Greek Yogurt with Chia Seeds & Kiwi
meals.image_prompt: a white ceramic bowl of thick Greek yogurt swirled with chia seeds topped with bright green kiwi slices, natural light, clean minimalist styling
day_of_steps: 1. Spoon 150g Greek yogurt into Diego's bowl; 120g into Diana's.
2. Stir in chia seeds: Diego 10g, Diana 8g.
3. Peel and slice 1 kiwi per person; arrange on top.
4. Drizzle 1 tsp honey over each and serve.

meals.name: Asian Miso Soup with Edamame, Tofu & Brown Rice
meals.image_prompt: steaming Japanese-style miso soup bowl with silken tofu cubes, edamame beans and wakame seaweed, a small bowl of fluffy brown rice alongside, wooden chopsticks, soft natural light on a light linen place mat
day_of_steps: 1. Bring 700ml water to a simmer; do NOT boil hard.
2. Dissolve 2 tbsp white miso paste (pâte de miso blanc) in a ladle of hot water; stir back into pot.
3. Add 200g silken tofu (tofu soyeux) cut into small cubes; 100g frozen edamame; 1 tbsp dried wakame seaweed (algue wakame séchée).
4. Simmer 3–4 min gently until edamame are tender; do not boil.
5. Cook 300g dry brown rice (or use leftover); reheat in microwave if using leftovers.
6. Ladle miso soup: Diego receives approx. 60% (350ml), Diana 40% (250ml), dividing tofu and edamame proportionally.
7. Serve with brown rice: Diego 200g, Diana 150g.
8. Garnish with sliced spring onions (ciboulette) and sesame seeds.

ingredients.item: White miso paste (pâte de miso blanc)
White miso paste (pâte de miso blanc)

meals.name: Celery Sticks & Almond Butter
meals.image_prompt: crisp green celery sticks arranged on a small plate beside a ramekin of smooth almond butter, natural light, clean and simple food photography
day_of_steps: 1. Wash and cut 3 celery sticks (céleri branche) per person.
2. Measure almond butter: Diego 25g, Diana 18g.
3. Serve celery with almond butter for dipping.

meals.name: Baked Mackerel with Sweet Potato Mash & Green Beans
meals.image_prompt: a golden-baked mackerel fillet on a white plate alongside a smooth orange sweet potato mash and bright green beans, lemon wedge, fresh dill garnish, warm Sunday dinner light, elegant rustic plating
day_of_steps: 1. Preheat oven to 200°C.
2. Peel and cube 2 medium sweet potatoes (patates douces); boil 15 min until tender; drain.
3. Mash with 1 tsp butter, splash of milk, salt and nutmeg.
4. Place mackerel fillets (maquereau — Diego 180g, Diana 130g) on a lined baking tray; season with salt, pepper, lemon zest and fresh dill.
5. Bake mackerel 12–14 min until cooked through and skin is crisp.
6. Steam green beans (haricots verts — Diego 100g, Diana 80g) 4–5 min until tender-crisp.
7. Serve mackerel over sweet potato mash with green beans alongside.
8. Squeeze fresh lemon over fish and serve.
